market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political activist with negligible national recognition and no major party or electoral base. Historically, the second-place finisher in the first round of Brazilian presidential elections is a heavyweight candidate (e.g., Bolsonaro, Haddad, Serra). The market price of 5.8% vastly overstates the chance of an obscure figure finishing runner-up in 2026. I estimate a true probability of around 0.5%.
evidence_points: Renan Santos has never won elected office and lacks a broad electoral coalition.
Second-place finishers in recent first rounds (2018, 2022) were major party nominees, not fringe candidates.
No polling or credible analysis places him as a contender for the presidency in 2026.
